architecture.trunk: Linear(d_in,384) GELU Dropout -> Linear(384,384) GELU Dropout -> Linear(384,192) GELU

ensemble: mean of per-seed pmfs, then invert (NOT mean of quantiles)
selection: median best-step across the purged walk-forward ladder at horizon_days=10, then refit on all of train
gate: FAILS DESIGN 7.7 check 3 (coverage 17/20, needs 20/20). NOT promoted.
known_limitation: Calibrated for uptrending and choppy markets. All three coverage failures are 2022, the only sustained decline in train+validate. Train is 90.9% uptrend by index-above-200SMA; validate is 58.8%.
revision_notes: signal_type added as a categorical feature (ADR 173): the model was never told whether a signal is a long or a short, and fwd_ret_* is the raw price return rather than the position return. The measured_on_validate figures below PREDATE both that change and the seeding fix, and are retained only as the record of what ADR 172's holdout run scored.
reproducibility_warning: Every figure here was measured before 2026-09-04, when `_run` built the module BEFORE calling torch.manual_seed -- so initial weights were unseeded and the seeds controlled only the batch shuffle. Two runs of identical code gave step counts [364, 384, 372] and [437, 323, 510], and validate coverage 17/20 and 14/20. Seeding order is fixed and cuDNN pinned as of that date; these numbers have NOT been re-measured under the fix.
